review: Allora — there is Italian! I have been translating choruses by hand on Thursday nights for two years and there is an Italian album and nobody told me. "Alleluia di Domenica Mattina." Eighty of us meet above a garage and we sing for two hours and this is the first thing I have not had to explain first. My father calls our group a sect. He has said it at the table twice, in front of everyone. I will not play him this. I would like to. Five stars, grazie.
